questions.question: How does filter: drop-shadow() differ from the standard box-shadow property?
options: drop-shadow only works in black and white
drop-shadow casts a shadow around the exact alpha contours of transparent PNGs and SVGs, rather than the rectangular box
box-shadow is hardware accelerated, drop-shadow is not
questions.explanation: filter: drop-shadow() respects the transparent alpha mask of SVGs and images, unlike box-shadow which always follows the rectangular bounding box.

questions.question: What happens if a developer writes button { outline: none; } without providing an alternative focus style?
options: Keyboard navigation users cannot see which element has focus, violating WCAG accessibility standards
questions.explanation: Stripping outline without a replacement leaves keyboard users unable to perceive focus, violating accessibility standards.

questions.question: Which property creates the modern 'frosted glass' blur effect over content behind an element?
questions.hint: backdrop-filter affects the backdrop behind the element.
questions.explanation: backdrop-filter applies graphical effects (like blurring) to the area behind a translucent element.

questions.question: What is the primary difference between border and outline?
options: border can have colors, outline cannot
border takes up physical space within the box model, while outline is drawn outside and takes up zero layout space
questions.hint: outline does not affect box model geometry.
questions.explanation: Outlines are drawn outside the element's border and do not consume layout space or trigger reflows.

questions.question: How do you create a pill-shaped button with fully rounded ends?
questions.hint: A very large radius value like 9999px.
questions.explanation: Setting border-radius to a large value like 9999px (or border-radius: 100vw) caps the radius at half the height, producing a perfect pill shape.
